from arena import Arena
from arena.mapgen import bordered_world
from arena.save import dumps, loads

def test_save_shield_roundtrip():
    g=Arena(1,bordered_world(7,7)); a=g.add_player(); a.shield=4
    world,_=loads(dumps(g.world,g.bags))
    assert world.actors['hero'].shield==4

def test_save_version1_compat():
    # Test compatibility with version-1 saves that omit shield
    old_save = '{"version": 1, "actors": [{"actor_id": "hero", "pos": [3,3], "hp": 10, "max_hp": 10, "attack": 5, "faction": "player", "glyph": "H", "statuses": {}}]}'
    world, bags = loads(old_save)
    assert world.actors['hero'].shield == 0
    assert world.actors['hero'].max_shield == 5

def test_save_inventory_roundtrip():
    g=Arena(1,bordered_world(7,7)); a=g.add_player()
    bag = g.bags['hero']
    bag.add('potion', power=5)
    bag.add('ant', power=1)
    bag.add('shield_tonic', power=3)
    world, bags = loads(dumps(g.world, g.bags))
    assert bags['hero'].items == [('potion', 5), ('ant', 1), ('shield_tonic', 3)]

def test_save_event_sequence():
    g=Arena(1,bordered_world(7,7)); a=g.add_player()
    g.world.emit('test_event', 'hero')
    world, bags = loads(dumps(g.world, g.bags))
    assert len(world.events) == 1
    assert world.events[0].seq == 1

def test_save_all_state():
    g=Arena(1,bordered_world(7,7)); a=g.add_player()
    a.shield=3
    a.statuses['poison']=2
    bag = g.bags['hero']
    bag.add('potion', power=5)
    g.world.emit('test', 'hero', amount=10)
    world, bags = loads(dumps(g.world, g.bags))
    assert world.actors['hero'].shield == 3
    assert world.actors['hero'].statuses['poison'] == 2
    assert bags['hero'].items == [('potion', 5)]
    assert len(world.events) == 1
"}

# req: R8.1
from arena import Arena
from arena.mapgen import bordered_world
from arena.save import dumps, loads

def test_save_shield_roundtrip():
    g=Arena(1,bordered_world(7,7)); a=g.add_player(); a.shield=4
    world,_=loads(dumps(g.world,g.bags))
    assert world.actors['hero'].shield==4

def test_save_version1_compat():
    # Test compatibility with version-1 saves that omit shield
    old_save = '{"version": 1, "actors": [{"actor_id": "hero", "pos": [3,3], "hp": 10, "max_hp": 10, "attack": 5, "faction": "player", "glyph": "H", "statuses": {}}]}'
    world, bags = loads(old_save)
    assert world.actors['hero'].shield == 0
    assert world.actors['hero'].max_shield == 5

def test_save_inventory_roundtrip():
    g=Arena(1,bordered_world(7,7)); a=g.add_player()
    bag = g.bags['hero']
    bag.add('potion', power=5)
    bag.add('ant', power=1)
    bag.add('shield_tonic', power=3)
    world, bags = loads(dumps(g.world, g.bags))
    assert bags['hero'].items == [('potion', 5), ('ant', 1), ('shield_tonic', 3)]

def test_save_event_sequence():
    g=Arena(1,bordered_world(7,7)); a=g.add_player()
    g.world.emit('test_event', 'hero')
    world, bags = loads(dumps(g.world, g.bags))
    assert len(world.events) == 1
    assert world.events[0].seq == 1

def test_save_all_state():
    g=Arena(1,bordered_world(7,7)); a=g.add_player()
    a.shield=3
    a.statuses['poison']=2
    bag = g.bags['hero']
    bag.add('potion', power=5)
    g.world.emit('test', 'hero', amount=10)
    world, bags = loads(dumps(g.world, g.bags))
    assert world.actors['hero'].shield == 3
    assert world.actors['hero'].statuses['poison'] == 2
    assert bags['hero'].items == [('potion', 5)]
    assert len(world.events) == 1
